## Services
- SMB AI ROI Audit & Roadmap: workflow review, tool recommendations, prioritized 90-day plan.
- Team AI Upskilling & Hands-On Workshops: interactive half-day workshops, prompt libraries, cheat sheets.
- Practical Workflow Automation: simple AI workflows for drafting, reporting, inquiries and content.
- AI Safe-Use Policy & Governance: 2-page acceptable-use policy, Law 25 privacy checklist, staff guidelines (practical guidance, not legal advice).
- Speaking for business groups and networking organizations (e.g., BNI chapters, chambers).
Pricing: scoped per project after a free discovery call. No public price list.
